analysis_scope: Current revision analysis; production source unchanged; repository report and portable evidence only.
limitations: One physical Apple M4, unpinned macOS scheduling, one eight-worker request configuration; no CI, remote or VM measurements.
Three measured ordinary samples per case; one instrumented stage sample per case. Ordinary and instrumented timings are separate observations.
Nested parallel work counters are elapsed worker durations, not process CPU and not additional wall phases.
REC operator probes use serial deterministic synthetic features at two shapes and exclude the vocabulary head.
Library latency starts with decoded BGR24 pixels. File acquisition, JPEG/PNG decode, serialization, alignment/token boxes, engine admission waiting and concurrent throughput are unmeasured.
This is a baseline and optimization analysis, without a new candidate or a measured speedup claim. Historical measurements are not pooled.

import hashlib
import json
import math
import pathlib
import re
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if (OUT / 'report.json').exists():
    raise SystemExit('Use a fresh output directory; existing measurements must not be overwritten or rerun.')
manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'tests/baseline/manifest.json').read_text())
fixtures = ['imgs_1', 'imgs_00018069', 'imgs_00006737']
models = ['tiny', 'small', 'medium']
budget = 60.0
source_paths = sorted((ROOT/'src').rglob('*.rs')) + sorted((ROOT/'tools').rglob('*.rs')) + sorted((ROOT/'examples').glob('*.rs')) + [ROOT/'Cargo.toml', ROOT/'Cargo.lock', ROOT/'rust-toolchain.toml']
elapsed = 0.0
commands = []

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def run(command, name, timeout=10):
    global elapsed
    assert elapsed < budget, 'aggregate execution budget exhausted'
    begin = time.monotonic()
    with (OUT / (name + '.json')).open('w') as output, (OUT / (name + '.stderr')).open('w') as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=output, stderr=err,
                                timeout=min(timeout, budget-elapsed))
    duration = time.monotonic()-begin
    elapsed += duration
    commands.append(dict(command=[str(x) for x in command], elapsed_seconds=duration))
    assert result.returncode == 0, (name, result.returncode)
    print(name, f'{duration:.3f}s; aggregate {elapsed:.3f}s', flush=True)
    return json.loads((OUT / (name + '.json')).read_text())

def compare(expected, actual):
    for key in ['id', 'text', 'detected_count', 'detector_resized_width', 'detector_resized_height']:
        assert expected[key] == actual[key], key
    assert len(expected['lines']) == len(actual['lines'])
    for e, a in zip(expected['lines'], actual['lines']):
        for key in ['text', 'classification_label', 'applied_rotation_degrees', 'emitted_count',
                    'recognition_content_width', 'recognition_tensor_width', 'recognition_time_steps']:
            assert e[key] == a[key], key
        for key in ['detection_score', 'recognition_score', 'classification_score']:
            assert math.isfinite(a[key]) and abs(e[key]-a[key]) <= 1e-4+1e-4*abs(e[key]), key
        for ep, ap in zip(e['points'], a['points']):
            assert all(math.isfinite(y) and abs(x-y) <= 0.5 for x,y in zip(ep,ap))

for asset in manifest['assets']:
    actual = sha(ROOT.parent/'SimdPaddleOCR/models'/asset['file'])
    assert actual in [asset['sha256'], asset.get('sha256_crlf')], asset['file']

jobs = {}
for fixture in fixtures:
    spec = next(f for f in manifest['fixtures'] if f['id'] == fixture)
    candidates = sorted((ROOT/'target/cpu-benchmark').glob('*/'+fixture+'.bgr'), reverse=True)
    original = next(p for p in candidates if sha(p) == spec['pixel_sha256'])
    pixels = OUT/(fixture+'.bgr')
    shutil.copyfile(original, pixels)
    assert pixels.stat().st_size == spec['width']*spec['height']*3
    for model in models:
        job = dict(manifest=str(ROOT/'tests/baseline/manifest.json'),
                   models=str(ROOT.parent/'SimdPaddleOCR/models'), model=model, fixture=fixture,
                   pixels=str(pixels), pixel_sha256=sha(pixels), width=spec['width'], height=spec['height'],
                   threads=8, concurrency=1, runs=3, affinity='unbound')
        path = OUT/(model+'-'+fixture+'.job.json')
        path.write_text(json.dumps(job, indent=2)+'\n')
        jobs[model,fixture] = path

provenance = dict(head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
                  status_before=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=ROOT,text=True),
                  machine=subprocess.check_output(['sysctl','-n','machdep.cpu.brand_string','hw.physicalcpu','hw.logicalcpu','hw.memsize'],text=True).strip(),
                  os=subprocess.check_output(['sw_vers'],text=True).strip(),
                  rustc=subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-Vv'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
                  manifest_sha256=sha(ROOT/'tests/baseline/manifest.json'),
                  assets=manifest['assets'], fixture_specs=[f for f in manifest['fixtures'] if f['id'] in fixtures],
                  power_source=subprocess.check_output(['pmset','-g','batt'],text=True).strip(),
                  thermal_status=subprocess.check_output(['pmset','-g','therm'],text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip(),
                  executable_sha256={name:sha(OUT/name) for name in ['cpu_benchmark','cpu_profile']},
                  production_source_sha256={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in source_paths},
                  settings=manifest['settings'], threads=8, concurrency=1,
                  scheduling='unpinned macOS; automatic NEON/FMA; default parallel; batch1; owned ordinary results; profiling separate',
                  performance_budget_seconds=budget)
(OUT/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n')
summary=[]
for model in models:
    golden = json.loads((ROOT/'tests/baseline/expected'/(model+'.json')).read_text())
    for fixture in fixtures:
        result = run([str(OUT/'cpu_benchmark'),'_worker',str(jobs[model,fixture])], model+'-'+fixture+'-benchmark')
        expected = next(c for c in golden['cases'] if c['id']==fixture)
        compare(expected,result['result'])
        samples=result['samples_ms']
        summary.append(dict(model=model,fixture=fixture,ordinary_median_ms=statistics.median(samples),
                            ordinary_range_ms=[min(samples),max(samples)],load_compile_ms=result['load_compile_ms'],
                            first_inference_ms=result['first_inference_ms'],ordinary_samples_ms=samples,
                            process_cpu_samples_ms=result['process_cpu']['samples_ms'],
                            golden_comparison_passed=True,lines=len(result['result']['lines']),
                            peak_resident_bytes=result['peak_resident_bytes'], ordinary_measurement=result))
for row in summary:
    model,fixture=row['model'],row['fixture']
    result=run([str(OUT/'cpu_profile'),model,fixture,'8'],model+'-'+fixture+'-profile')
    assert result['complete_owned_outputs_exactly_equal']
    row['profile']=result
    stage=result['profile']
    phases=['det_preprocess_ns','det_inference_ns','det_postprocess_ns','crop_ns',
            'classification_wall_ns','recognition_wall_ns']
    row['profile_wall_remainder_ns']=stage['total_ns']-sum(stage[k] for k in phases)
    row['profile_stage_wall_shares_percent']={k:100*stage[k]/stage['total_ns'] for k in phases}

# Existing test-only fused-production instrumentation, fixed one warm-up + one
# timed pass per stage/model/shape. Serial REC uses synthetic input, not page latency.
test_log=(OUT/'correctness.log').read_text()
test_binary=test_log.split('Running unittests src/lib.rs (',1)[1].split(')',1)[0]
provenance['diagnostic_executable_sha256']=sha(ROOT/test_binary)
diagnostics=[]
for test in ['sparse_detector_production_steps','recognition_backbone_physical_steps']:
    command=[str(ROOT/test_binary),'runtime::optimized::tests::performance::'+test,
             '--exact','--ignored','--nocapture','--test-threads=1']
    assert elapsed < budget
    start=time.monotonic()
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=min(12,budget-elapsed))
    duration=time.monotonic()-start
    elapsed+=duration
    (OUT/(test+'.log')).write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
    commands.append(dict(command=command,elapsed_seconds=duration))
    assert result.returncode==0, (test,result.stdout,result.stderr)
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        match=re.search(r'(small|medium) REC width=(\d+) .*total_step_ms=([\d.]+); groups=(\{.*\})',line)
        if match:
            diagnostics.append(dict(kind='recognition_backbone',model=match[1],
                shape=[1,3,48,int(match[2])],threads=1,
                input='deterministic synthetic; excludes vocabulary head',
                total_step_ms=float(match[3]),groups_ms=json.loads(match[4]),
                outputs_exactly_equal=True,top_steps=[]))
        elif re.match(r'[\d.]+ms node=',line) and diagnostics[-1].get('kind')=='recognition_backbone':
            ms,description=line.split('ms ',1)
            diagnostics[-1]['top_steps'].append(dict(ms=float(ms),description=description))
        elif ' {"' in line:
            payload=line[line.index('{'):]
            diagnostics.append(json.loads(payload))
    print(test,f'{duration:.3f}s; aggregate {elapsed:.3f}s',flush=True)

assert provenance['production_source_sha256']=={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in source_paths}
assert len(diagnostics)==5
report=dict(provenance=provenance,cases=summary,diagnostics=diagnostics,commands=commands,
            performance_execution_seconds=elapsed,
            counts=dict(ordinary_cases=9,ordinary_first_runs=9,ordinary_warmups=9,ordinary_measured_runs=27,
                        profile_cases=9,profile_warmups=9,profile_measured_runs=9,
                        detector_diagnostic_warmups=3,detector_diagnostic_measured_runs=3,
                        recognizer_diagnostic_warmups=2,recognizer_diagnostic_measured_runs=2))
(OUT/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Report:',OUT/'report.json',flush=True)
